vehicle.title: Honda Civic Type R
vehicle.subtitle: 2025 Honda Civic Type R (FL5)
vehicle.sourceLabel: Reference photographs by Bruno Silie / Maison Throne

views.label: Square front (straight-on)
views.credit: Bruno Silie / Maison Throne via Bring a Trailer (Lot #231,834, seller Hobie109)
views.note: rev-03 verified (fit 12.2 px/1k (44 px on 11 lm), held-out 11.0 px/1k (6 lm); silhouette med 8.9 px/1k (IoU 0.897); hood unlatched 0.025). Raked dark-smoked triple-LED headlamps with gloss-black under-lamp mask, deeper V-dipped upper grille, corrected wider-at-top lower intercooler trapezoid, front H & Type R badges, and wider forward hood extractor vent all track the photo cleanly.

views.label: Front-right three-quarter
views.credit: Bruno Silie / Maison Throne via Bring a Trailer (Lot #231,834, seller Hobie109)
views.note: rev-03 verified (fit 3.8 px/1k (14 px on 10 lm), held-out 15.1 px/1k (5 lm); silhouette med 8.4 px/1k (IoU 0.900)). Raked headlamp wrap, flush fender-to-hood seam, wider-at-top lower grille cheek contour, hood vent placement, widebody fender blisters, matte-black 19" wheels with red Brembo front calipers, and roofline header align tightly.

views.label: Side profile (right)
views.credit: Bruno Silie / Maison Throne via Bring a Trailer (Lot #231,834, seller Hobie109)
views.note: rev-03 verified (fit 8.1 px/1k (29 px on 10 lm), held-out 27.7 px/1k (8 lm); silhouette med 9.6 px/1k (IoU 0.827); hood unlatched 0.025). Wheelbase, greenhouse silhouette, extended headlamp/taillamp side wrap, aft rear door handle, tall gloss-black rear side-sill kick-up winglet, rounded rear bumper corner, shark fin on roof panel, and wing setback align along the full profile.

views.label: Rear-right three-quarter
views.credit: Bruno Silie / Maison Throne via Bring a Trailer (Lot #231,834, seller Hobie109)
views.note: rev-03 verified (fit 6.0 px/1k (22 px on 7 lm), held-out 22.6 px/1k (6 lm); silhouette med 11.2 px/1k (IoU 0.881)). Tall dark-smoked boomerang taillamps with inner crimson C-light-guide, U-shaped tailgate cutline, rounded lower bumper corners, lowered Pennsylvania license plate & badges, raised triple-outlet exhaust, vertical reflector bezel, and tightened gloss-black rear wing match cleanly.

views.label: Square rear (straight-on)
views.credit: Bruno Silie / Maison Throne via Bring a Trailer (Lot #231,834, seller Hobie109)
views.note: rev-03 verified (fit 12.4 px/1k (45 px on 8 lm), held-out 15.2 px/1k (6 lm); silhouette med 10.6 px/1k (IoU 0.891)). Tall smoked boomerang C-taillamps, U-shaped hatch shutline, tightened gloss-black rear wing (±0.672 m) with open-webbing aluminum stays, lowered rear plate with full lettering, raised triple exhaust (Z=0.270 m), and rounded rear haunches match straight-on symmetry.

views.label: Rear-left three-quarter
views.credit: Bruno Silie / Maison Throne via Bring a Trailer (Lot #231,834, seller Hobie109)
views.note: rev-03 verified (fit 7.2 px/1k (26 px on 7 lm), held-out 22.5 px/1k (6 lm); silhouette med 11.5 px/1k (IoU 0.850); hood unlatched 0.025). Confirms left/right symmetry of tall smoked boomerang taillamps, U-shaped tailgate cutline, lowered plate & badges, raised triple exhaust & 4-strake diffuser, rounded rear bumper corners, aft rear door handle, and tall rear rocker winglet.

views.label: Side profile (left)
views.credit: Bruno Silie / Maison Throne via Bring a Trailer (Lot #231,834, seller Hobie109)
views.note: rev-03 verified (fit 5.8 px/1k (21 px on 10 lm), held-out 26.4 px/1k (8 lm); silhouette med 9.9 px/1k (IoU 0.857); hood unlatched 0.025). Mirrors side-right lock: flush nose profile, accurate headlamp/taillamp side wrap, aft rear door handle, tall gloss-black rear sill kick-up, matte-black 19" Y-spoke wheels with red Brembo calipers, roof shark-fin setback, and rear wing sweep.

views.label: Front-left three-quarter
views.credit: Bruno Silie / Maison Throne via Bring a Trailer (Lot #231,834, seller Hobie109)
views.note: rev-03 verified (fit 6.6 px/1k (24 px on 10 lm), held-out 14.1 px/1k (4 lm); silhouette med 12.8 px/1k (IoU 0.864); hood unlatched 0.025). Confirms symmetric front fixes on driver side: raked dark-smoked LED headlamp & black under-lamp mask, smooth hood/fender shoulder, corrected wider-at-top lower grille trapezoid, forward hood vent, and widebody front fender extraction vent.

views.label: High rear-right three-quarter

views.label: High square rear

views.label: High roof & windshield crown (front-left)

views.label: High rear roof & shark-fin antenna (rear-right)

views.note: rev-03 verified (fit 27.5 px/1k (99 px on 6 lm), held-out 180.6 px/1k (1 lm)). Refitted camera and +25.5 cm forward-shifted shark-fin antenna (X=-0.955..-0.800 m on white roof panel ahead of hatch glass seam) align the shark fin, smooth roof crown taper, hatch glass top edge, and C-pillar rail cleanly.

views.label: Test view: close square front (hood latched)
views.credit: Bruno Silie / Maison Throne via Bring a Trailer (Lot #231,834, seller Hobie109)
views.note: rev-03 HELD-BACK TEST VIEW verified (fit 14.0 px/1k (50 px on 10 lm), held-out 25.2 px/1k (3 lm); hood fully latched). views.label: Test view: mid rear-right three-quarter
views.credit: Bruno Silie / Maison Throne via Bring a Trailer (Lot #231,834, seller Hobie109)
views.note: rev-03 HELD-BACK TEST VIEW verified (fit 16.7 px/1k (60 px on 8 lm), held-out 24.9 px/1k (3 lm)). Independent mid-height 39mm test confirms tall smoked boomerang taillamps, U-shaped hatch cutline, rounded rear bumper corner, 4-strake diffuser depth, raised triple exhaust centering, vertical reflector pocket, and aluminum wing stays.

views.label: Test view: high rear-left three-quarter
views.credit: Bruno Silie / Maison Throne via Bring a Trailer (Lot #231,834, seller Hobie109)
views.note: rev-03 HELD-BACK TEST VIEW verified (fit 23.9 px/1k (86 px on 7 lm), held-out 35.5 px/1k (2 lm)). Independent opposite-side 28mm high test confirms left/right symmetry of tightened rear wing airfoil & endplates, tall smoked left taillamp, hatch glass taper, fuel-door proximity to C-pillar, and rear wiper placement.

views.label: Front-left corner, illuminated DRL & Type R badge

Close-up confirms raked illuminated L-shaped white LED DRL inside dark smoked housing, gloss-black under-lamp mask, front grille Type R badge, wider-at-top lower honeycomb grille, intercooler core, and vertical air-curtain slot.

views.label: Left LED taillamp (lit) & CIVIC badge

views.label: Right LED taillamp (lit) & Type R badge
views.credit: Bruno Silie / Maison Throne via Bring a Trailer (Lot #231,834, seller Hobie109)
views.note: rev-03 verified (fit 86.0 px/1k (310 px on 5 lm), held-out 137.0 px/1k (1 lm)). views.label: Gloss-black rear wing & die-cast aluminum stays

views.note: rev-03 verified (fit 55.8 px/1k (201 px on 7 lm), held-out 73.0 px/1k (1 lm)). views.label: Right gloss-black power side mirror

views.note: rev-03 verified (fit 62.0 px/1k (223 px on 6 lm), held-out 81.1 px/1k (1 lm)). Lofted inset mirror glass eliminates prior housing poke-through; refitted camera (anchored on A-pillar sail & front-right wheel hub) confirms door-mounted gloss-black mirror housing, stalk below beltline, and outer LED turn-signal strip.

views.label: Left widebody front fender & functional side vent
views.credit: Bruno Silie / Maison Throne via Bring a Trailer (Lot #231,834, seller Hobie109)
views.note: rev-03 verified (fit 19.7 px/1k (71 px on 7 lm), held-out 173.3 px/1k (2 lm)). Wheel-anchored refit (6 front-left wheel landmarks) locks widebody front fender blister contour, functional vertical wheel-arch extraction vent with black louvers, front-left 19" wheel & red Brembo caliper, lower rocker, and front door seam.

views.label: Center-mounted triple-outlet exhaust & diffuser

views.label: Front-left 19" Y-spoke wheel, Michelin PS4S & Brembo brake

views.label: Rear-left 19" wheel, solid rotor & red rear caliper
views.credit: Bruno Silie / Maison Throne via Bring a Trailer (Lot #231,834, seller Hobie109)

views.label: Open rear hatch (rear-right three-quarter)

views.note: rev-03 verified (fit 12.2 px/1k (44 px on 7 lm), held-out 12.2 px/1k (2 lm); hatch=1.0 at -72 deg). Open hatch pivot, lift height, interior cargo aperture, sculpted rear bench & red front bucket silhouettes, tall smoked taillamps, raised triple exhaust, and rounded rear bumper corner align cleanly.

views.label: Open rear hatch (square rear)
views.credit: Bruno Silie / Maison Throne via Bring a Trailer (Lot #231,834, seller Hobie109)
views.note: rev-03 verified (fit 9.7 px/1k (35 px on 6 lm), held-out 38.1 px/1k (2 lm); hatch=1.0 at -72 deg). views.label: Open hood & K20C1 engine bay (front-left 3/4)

views.label: Open hood & K20C1 engine bay (square front)
views.credit: Bruno Silie / Maison Throne via Bring a Trailer (Lot #231,834, seller Hobie109)
views.note: rev-03 verified (fit 18.5 px/1k (67 px on 8 lm), held-out 27.6 px/1k (2 lm); hood=1.15 at +59.8 deg). Square-front open-hood view confirms wide +59.8 deg clearance, symmetric white strut towers, reshaped red K20C1 valve cover with HONDA script, diagonal carbon TYPE R cover, corrugated hose, silver turbo heat shield, airbox, and battery red terminal cover (fit improved 150->67 px).

views.label: Cabin & dashboard overview

Dashboard width & symmetry lock on 10.2" digital cluster, 9" floating Honda LogR screen, raised honeycomb vent strip with red bezel & R-41430 plaque, raised/tightened 3 red-ringed HVAC dials (holdout improved 244->86 px), sport pedals, and brushed console with teardrop shifter & 4-switch bank.

views.label: Honeycomb dashboard vent mesh & plaque R-41430

views.label: Center console, aluminum teardrop shift knob & +R toggle

views.label: Rear-right open door card & suede trim

views.note: rev-03 verified (fit 48.5 px/1k (175 px on 5 lm), held-out 129.6 px/1k (1 lm); doorRR=1.0, rear-right door isolated). views.label: Rear two-passenger black cloth bench & red seatbelts
views.credit: Bruno Silie / Maison Throne via Bring a Trailer (Lot #231,834, seller Hobie109)

views.label: Front underside & aero undertray
views.credit: Bruno Silie / Maison Throne via Bring a Trailer (Lot #231,834, seller Hobie109)
views.note: rev-03 verified (fit 10.6 px/1k (38 px on 5 lm), held-out 27.9 px/1k (1 lm); hideFloor=true, 4-tire ground-plane refit). Front and rear 265 mm tire contact patches (fit 38 px / 10.6 px/1k), front lower wishbones, flat stamped aluminum engine undertray, and central exhaust tunnel align cleanly; mild upward bow along the upper front bumper lip reflects iPhone 15 Pro 14mm ultra-wide radial distortion vs pinhole camera.

views.label: Rear underside, triple-outlet muffler & diffuser
views.credit: Bruno Silie / Maison Throne via Bring a Trailer (Lot #231,834, seller Hobie109)
views.note: rev-03 verified (fit 5.2 px/1k (19 px on 6 lm), held-out 19.4 px/1k (1 lm); hideFloor=true). Tightly locks rear 265 mm tire treads, 4-strake rear diffuser underside, raised three-canister stainless steel rear muffler, central exhaust mid-pipe routing, and multi-link rear subframe (minor edge bow from 14mm ultra-wide lens distortion).
